title: MANIX SMP ESSENTIAL
body:
🔥 **MANIX SMP ESSENTIAL Modpack**

A carefully optimized Fabric modpack designed for a smooth, stable, and immersive multiplayer survival experience in **MANIX SMP**.

---

## ⚡ Performance First

Built with a powerful optimization stack to deliver high FPS, fast loading, and stable gameplay even with multiple players online.

---

## 🌍 Enhanced Exploration

Experience a richer Minecraft world across all dimensions:

* 🏞️ Overworld filled with new structures and points of interest
* 🔥 Expanded Nether powered by Incendium
* 🌌 Revamped End using Nullscape and enhanced progression

---

## 🛡️ SMP-Friendly Design

This modpack is built with multiplayer in mind:

* 🧭 Waystones for fast and convenient travel
* 🎒 Backpack system for extended inventory management
* ⚖️ Balanced progression that encourages exploration and teamwork

---

## 🧰 Additional Gameplay Features

Several enhancements are included to improve your survival experience:

* 🐺 Improved wolf companions and pet mechanics
* 🛡️ Extra armor and gear options for companions
* 📦 Death chest system to safely recover items after death
* 🔧 Uncrafting system to break down crafted items
* 🧪 Ability to obtain normally uncraftable items
* ✨ Expanded enchantment system
* ⛏️ Improved ore and resource mechanics

💡 Full details, guides, and tips are available in the Discord server.

---

## 🧩 Choose Your Experience (IMPORTANT)

This modpack is available in **3 versions**, all fully playable. Choose based on your preference:

### 🥔 Lite

* Core gameplay + performance mods only
* Clean, lightweight, and smooth
  👉 Ideal for maximum performance or simple gameplay



### ⚖️ Medium

* Balanced mix of performance and visuals
* Includes some animations and enhancements
  👉 A well-rounded experience for most players



### ✨ High

* Full visuals, animations, particles, and sound enhancements
* Most immersive version of MANIX SMP
  👉 Experience the game with all features enabled



💡 You can try any version and switch anytime based on your preference.

---

## 📢 Optional Features Notice

This modpack does not include built-in voice chat or land claiming systems by default.

* 🎤 Players can use Discord for communication
* 🛡️ Protection or additional systems may be added in future updates based on community feedback

---

## 📦 Important Notes

* Requires Fabric Loader
* Compatible with Minecraft **1.21.1**
* Includes all required dependencies

---

## 🚀 Installation

Install using the **Modrinth App**, select your preferred version, and join the server.

---

🔥 **Enjoy your adventure in MANIX SMP**
